comparator.name: Science, Business & Innovation
comparator.sourceNotes: The 2026–2027 regulations and catalogue agree on 150 EC of compulsory study and 30 EC of electives. Energy and life science are application domains within one degree. The 24 EC external research project requires passing Research Design and Methodology with no more than 18 EC of other units outstanding. Language clearance and laboratory safety are integrated requirements. The regulations record the applied informatics merger relevant to Modelling.
components: Waardegedreven innoveren, onderzoeken en ondernemen (+ tutoraat)
Strategic Management of Technology and Innovation

core: Interdisciplinary combination of exact sciences, business and innovation methodology
Turning scientific and technological knowledge into market-ready products and evaluating the technical and commercial feasibility of innovation
Project-based innovation work for real organisations
Research design and quantitative/qualitative innovation case-study methodology
Management, organisational behaviour and organisations undergoing change
Corporate social responsibility and sustainable business practice
Mathematical, statistical, computational and data-analytical foundations for technology and innovation decisions
Finance and financial decision-making for technology ventures
Ethical evaluation of innovation and responsible research; philosophy of science remains a specific comparator gap
adjacent: Sustainable energy technology, the energy transition and sustainability governance for companies and governments
Life-science and health innovation: biochemistry, human biology and disease/health-technology applications
questions: Illustrative current innovation applications the programme uses to introduce prospective students to the field (fuel-saving aircraft coatings, hydrogen transport and logistics, making buildings and operations more sustainable, developing medicines, advising an energy company, medical apps for home blood-glucose monitoring, AI and sound-wave technology for cancer diagnosis, predicting pregnancy risks in remote areas)

Career and further-study trajectories the programme prepares graduates for (energy and sustainability careers, healthcare-innovation consulting, new-business development, technology consulting and investment, pharmaceutical and biotech innovation management, production-process innovation, starting a science-based company, environment and resource management, innovation management, complex-systems engineering and management, the award-winning sharkskin aircraft-coating project)

trace: develops financial decision-making, risk-assessment and investment-analysis skills through case studies, studying related subject matter in Finance I's financial-analysis content for technology ventures.
introduces microeconomic and macroeconomic principles, a general business-science foundation supporting the programme's own interdisciplinary combination of exact sciences, business and innovation.

teaches OLS/GLS/instrumental-variables estimation and hypothesis testing through Monte Carlo simulation, studying related subject matter in Modelleren's quantitative/statistical modelling content and complementing the research-methodology concept.

examines how companies build strategy and drive responsible digital transformation amid technological change, studying related subject matter in Strategic Management of Technology and Innovation's strategic-technology-management content and the technology-and-innovation-strategy interest.

trains planning and conducting research into what customers want and turning findings into business ideas, a concrete complementary contribution to the technical-and-commercial-feasibility-of-innovation concept.

develops a new venture from ideation to pitch through design thinking, market validation and business planning, studying related subject matter in Ondernemerschap en Digitale Innovatie's entrepreneurship content and the technology-entrepreneurship interest.
teaches research design, sampling and descriptive/inferential statistics, studying related subject matter in Onderzoek ontwerp en methodologie's research-methodology content.

offers an interdisciplinary exploration of organisational behaviour, motivation and culture, studying related subject matter in the OER's own learning outcome on organisations and organisational change and the management-and-organisation interest.

develops data visualisation, cleaning and manipulation skills, a concrete complementary contribution to Science, Entrepreneurship & Digital Innovation's digital-innovation content and the OER's own learning outcome that graduates apply data analysis, modelling and AI technology.
teaches structured and object-oriented programming in Python, studying related subject matter in Toegepaste informatica & programmeren voor SBI's programming content.
teaches differentiation, integration and differential equations as the mathematical toolkit for the sciences, studying related subject matter in Calculus.
covers systems of linear equations, matrices and vector spaces, studying related subject matter in Lineaire algebra.
examines circular-economy strategies, resource security and stewardship, a concrete complementary contribution to the alternative-fuels interest.

examines how sustainability policy is made and enforced by governmental and non-governmental actors at local, national and international level, studying related subject matter in Innovatieproject energietransitie's energy-transition-governance content and the energy-transition-for-companies-and-governments interest.

introduces Earth Science broadly, including resource management, a complementary earth-science foundation for the sustainable-energy-innovation direction; UCR offers no physics or chemistry course reproducing Klassieke mechanica & thermodynamica's or Organic & Sustainable Chemistry's disciplinary content, so this remains a general complementary contribution rather than a substitute.

uses satellite and drone geospatial data to model how human actions change the Earth system, a concrete complementary contribution to the energy-transition-for-companies-and-governments direction's monitoring dimension.
conducts in-depth geoscience research into resource and environmental challenges including geothermal energy, a concrete complementary contribution to the sustainable-energy-innovation direction.

introduces sustainability science through the model of planetary boundaries with an anthropogenic focus, a concrete complementary foundation for Maatschappelijk verantwoord ondernemen en duurzaamheid's corporate-sustainability content.
extends sustainability science into waves, chemistry and materials science, a concrete complementary foundation for advanced renewable-energy-system design.

examines the drivers and impacts of anthropogenic climate change, including renewable-energy systems and carbon storage, a concrete complementary contribution to Innovatieproject energie's energy-innovation content and the sustainable-energy-innovation direction.

trains evaluating the environmental impact of products, processes and services across their lifecycle, a concrete complementary contribution to the direction's writing-a-business-plan-for-sustainable-technology interest.

trains assessing energy-usage patterns and designing solar, wind and bioenergy solutions with technical and economic analysis for a partner company, studying related subject matter in Duurzame Energie's sustainable-energy content and the sustainable-energy-innovation interest.
Moral theories and practicalethics provide7.5ECofnormative reasoning forresponsibleinnovation,notphilosophyofscience or a dedicatedtechnology-assessment course.
Qualitative research design, data collection, interpretation and reflexivity provide7.5ECofmethodological support for innovation case-study research; no technical product-design project is implied.

examines drugs' origin, mechanisms and therapeutic use, studying related subject matter in Van molecuul tot medicijn's molecule-to-medicine content and Innovatieproject geneesmiddelen's medicine-development project, and the developing-medicines interest.
examines the pathophysiology of six major organ systems through clinical cases, studying related subject matter in Innovatieproject diagnostiek & gezondheid's health-innovation-project content.

introduces the cells, molecules and biological systems that sustain life, a concrete complementary foundation for the life-science-and-health-innovation direction and Biochemie's/Van molecuul tot medicijn's introductory life-science content.
examines the cellular biology underlying industry, medicine and agriculture applications, studying related subject matter in Van molecuul tot medicijn's molecular foundations of medicine.
examines the normal functioning of human organ systems, a concrete complementary contribution to Innovatieproject diagnostiek & gezondheid's medical-technological market-application content.
examines the chemistry of life, including proteins, sugars, lipids and nucleic acids, studying related subject matter in Biochemie.

Blood/protein analysis,bacterialhandling,DNAisolation/PCR/electrophoresis andbioinformatics provide7.5ECofactualbiochemical/molecular laboratorypractice supportinghealth-innovation inquiry; notphysicslab ordiagnosticimaging.
examines cell injury, inflammation and the molecular basis of disease, a concrete complementary contribution to the mechanisms-of-disease and health-innovation content of the direction.
Regression,factoranalysis,AN(C)OVA,logisticregression andnonparametrictesting provide7.5ECofmultivariate evidence analysis for empirical life-science/business inquiry.

alternatives.label: Science, Business and Sustainable Innovation
alternatives.labelReason: Reviewed against every selected whole7.5ECcourse: A science-and-business programme combines entrepreneurship, strategy, finance and empirical research with renewable-energy systems and biomedical science. Biochemistry, pharmacology and disease mechanisms provide a life-science strand; energy-system design, life-cycle analysis and sustainability governance provide an energy strand. Mathematics, programming and data analysis support technical and commercial inquiry. It offers a substantive interdisciplinary response while lacking VU’s dedicated physics and organic-chemistry sequence, integrated innovation-project progression and compulsory research internship.

candidates.label: Sustainable Energy Innovation and the Energy Transition
Integrated technical innovation projects for organisations

selection.assessment: Three distinct responses combine genuine technical science, business and research methods. The mixed programme combines energy design and governance with biochemistry, drug action and disease. The energy programme deepens design, resource analysis and cleaner production. The life-science programme adds cellular, physiological, pathological and laboratory depth. The separately considered organisational project direction does not supply VU’s integrated technical innovation projects or external research. Dedicated physics, organic chemistry and clinical imaging remain gaps.

blocks: Financial decision-making, risk and investment analysis partly overlap with Finance I.
Digital strategy, organisational change and business-model design support technology and innovation strategy.
Venture ideation, market validation and business planning overlap with VU’s entrepreneurship module. Digital innovation differs.
Organisational behaviour, teams and leadership overlap with the study of innovation teams and organisations. Technology ventures and innovation-project practice differ.
Research design, sampling and statistics overlap. VU also uses innovation case studies and applied analysis in R.
Python programming provides a foundation for applied informatics. VU adds data processing and simulations in scientific contexts.
Differentiation, integration and differential equations overlap with calculus.
Vectors, matrices, linear systems and transformations provide direct linear algebra overlap.
Renewable-energy technologies and technical and economic assessment overlap with sustainable energy.
Drug targets, mechanisms and pharmacokinetics partly overlap with the study of how molecules become medicines. VU adds rational design, screening and imaging.
Biomolecules, enzymes and metabolism overlap directly with VU Biochemistry.

notes.text: UCR offers related science-and-business pathways. Biochemistry, laboratory methods, renewable-energy design and environmental chemistry contribute real science content. Dedicated physics, organic chemistry, diagnostic imaging and VU’s integrated innovation projects remain substantial differences.

VU includes a compulsory 24-EC research internship and 30 EC of approved electives. UCR’s scheduled 180 EC comprises taught courses; optional independent research is shown separately and does not reproduce the internship.

audience.programmeDescription: VU’s Dutch-taught degree combines physical and life sciences with entrepreneurship, strategy and finance. Students apply these fields to energy and health innovation and complete an individual research project with an external organisation.
audience.comparisonExplanation: The three UCR options combine science and business through a mixed energy and life-science plan, a renewable energy and resources plan, and a biomedical plan. Each builds relevant scientific and business skills. VU provides more dedicated physics, organic chemistry and diagnostic imaging, and integrates those subjects into a series of innovation projects.

curriculum.limitation: The 180 EC curriculum includes 30 EC of electives and a required 24 EC external research project. Laboratory safety, Dutch language assessment and tutoring also apply.

componentNotes.y1-innov-energy: Passing this project requires completing the Dutch language assessment or the required follow-up course.
componentNotes.y2-physics-lab: Requires passing the fire safety instruction and safety test.
componentNotes.y3-bachelor-project: Requires passing Research Design and Methodology with no more than 18 EC of other coursework outstanding.
componentNotes.y3-keuzeruimte: Students can choose an eligible minor or seek approval for an elective package or study abroad.
